description: This file defines the NoOpStreamDeliveryFailureHandler class that implements the IStreamFailureHandler interface. The class provides no-op implementations for handling stream delivery and subscription failures, essentially indicating no reaction to such failures.

classes.name: NoOpStreamDeliveryFailureHandler
classes.description: A stream failure handler that does nothing when failures occur.

methods.name: NoOpStreamDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler, with optional fault-on-error behavior.

methods.name: OnDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Handles delivery failure, but in this implementation does nothing and returns a completed task.

methods.name: OnSubscriptionFailure
methods.description: Handles subscription failure, but this implementation does nothing and returns a completed task.
